name: eric blaufarb
text:
Dr Imami & his entire staff were warm, welcoming, professional, and kind from the first call to the walk out to the car after the procedure by Dr. Imami.

There are many Dr's practices set-up to be professional, efficient, providing great results; I've been to many.

Then there are Dr's. practices that create a culture of kindness, healing, respect, & love along with being professional and efficient; these are rare diamonds.

Dr. Imami's practice & the environment he has cultivated over a long successful career extents from his practice to all the people he has touched, healed, and helped along the way.

If you are considering any type of restorative elective procedure and are unsure, tentative, anxious about these types of procedures, reach out to Dr. Imami and his team, you will feel cared for the moment he picks up the phone.

Thank you so much for helping pacients, teaching physicians, and having such a strong ethos of healing & caring.

Best Regards, and god bless to you your family and your two sons!

PS I can't wait to see the results from my FUT procedure sprout & grow :-)

Eric Blaufarb

Update for those who may be unsure how well this procedure works I've added 2 photos.  It's been about 4 months and the transplants are really coming in!  I cannot express how excellent the technicians were they spent 8 hours of focused work and their talent & dedication is unmistakable with these results!

Owner's reply
Wow—thank you for such a thoughtful and kind review! Your words truly mean the world to Dr. Imami and our entire team. We are honored to be part of your journey and grateful that you felt cared for from start to finish. Creating a culture of kindness, healing, and respect is at the heart of what we do, and knowing that this resonated with you is incredibly rewarding.

We’re excited for you to see the full results of your FUT procedure and look forward to celebrating your progress with you! Eric, please don’t hesitate to reach out if you ever need anything. Wishing you all the best, and thank you again for your trust and support!

name: Douglas Nicholson
text:
At the time of this writing, I am 8 months post my FUE procedure.

When I started this, I had an advanced thinned crown and receding front hairline but was not totally bald.  Needless to say, I was not happy when I looked in the mirror.  I was very uncomfortable (embarrassed) about even looking into hair restoration, but Dr. Imami and his staff were very understanding and wonderful people to work with.  Dr. Imami did 100% oversee every part of the prep, the FUE procedure, and the post/follow-up procedures I have done with them.  Yes, he has technicians that perform the procedure under his supervision, as every one of these offices do, so I don't know what a couple other reviewers that I saw on here were complaining about (if they weren't actually fake reviews).

If you are wondering, the FUE procedure itself wasn't bad.  A little uncomfortable until the numbing injections kick-in, but fine after that.  The first couple of nights after the procedure are a bit uncomfortable.  I had to sleep in a recliner for the first two nights to keep the pressure off of the donor area.  For me the recipient areas were relatively pain free right through the full healing period.  I think I just had more nerves in the donor area.  Your experience may vary.

I am very happy with the results so far, and I will be moving forward with a second procedure to get everything to where I want things to be.  I was a little worried about doing things in stages, but it has worked out very well for me.  The changes have been substantial, but subtle/gradual enough over the first 6-month healing and growing period, where people I work with and people who had not seen me in months, were not able to tell what had changed about me (even close relatives).  And yes, I did strategically wear baseball hats and such for the first month after the surgery. :-)

I was also happily surprised with the cost of the procedure.  I initially went in thinking they were going to tell me a huge number, and I would then walk away, saying no way can I afford that.  Thats not what happened though, so don't walk away from checking this out thinking you can't afford it, because you may be surprised like I was.

Not to sound crazy or anything, but this has not just restored my hairline, it has restored my self-image.  I was seriously depressed with myself.  Looking in the mirror was painful for me.   Doing this started me down a healthier path with myself.  It helped me get serious about losing weight and getting in shape as well. I feel great and I look better than I have in 15 years.

If you are thinking about doing this, do it.  I wish I hadn't waited as long as I did.
